lines: The language button moved from the sidebar to the top right of the Tools bar.

Spanish and Russian pages (beta): pick Español or Русский from the language button in the sidebar. Game names follow the game's own translations; tell us through Report a problem if something reads wrong.
The language button is now a menu: English, 简体中文, Español, Русский.
Ladder, short share links and Report a problem now use the address api.lilshrimper.dev, which also works in mainland China (the old address is blocked there).
Character tab: the large picture is sized by item type, so wands, daggers, tomes and other one-handers are drawn smaller than staves and other two-handers.
Character tab: the large weapon, off hand and body armour pictures are sharper.
Chinese: the site remembers it. After you pick 中文 (or open a Chinese link), the plain address opens in Chinese; browsers set to Chinese start there too. The EN button switches back for good.
Chinese (Simplified): every page now has a Chinese version (the 中文 button in the sidebar, or /zh/ addresses). Game names use the game's own Chinese; the translation is in beta.
Item Search: weapon bases show their DPS.
Item text: "Weapon damage per second" now reads "Weapon DPS".
Character tab: a Spare idols list beside the Fossil. Drag idols out to it while you re-arrange, add new ones there with +, and drag them back in. Spares are not counted.
Character tab: removing an idol no longer moves the other idols.
Item text: Fire, Cold and Lightning together read "Elemental", as in the game.
Character tab: the × on a gear slot or idol takes the item off right away, without a confirm pop-up.
Item Search and Grail: bases, uniques and runes now show the game's own item art (Game icons and art © Crater Studios).
Character tab: gear slots show the item's picture; weapon, off hand and body armour show it large with small text under it.
Character tab: idols now sit on the Dwarven Fossil grid, with their art. Click an empty cell to add one, drag to move, hold Ctrl while dragging to copy; share links keep where they sit.
Character tab: an × on each gear slot and idol takes the item off, and an idol can be duplicated from its item window.
Character tab: a Sim Supports button on each skill tries the support setups for it and sockets the one you pick. The main skill is listed first.
Item window: the item lists and the Edit tab show the item's picture.
Fossil Planner: idols are drawn with the game's art on the grid and in the lists.

Build planner: the off hand now takes one-handed weapons (wands and others) for dual wielding. A two-hander takes no off hand, and a quiver goes only with a bow; an off hand that no longer fits is taken off with a note.
Gear Set Sim: Max Riven mods now starts at 0 (no Riven mods). Raise it or clear the box to allow them. The Riven and Vows boxes are highlighted.
Gear Set Sim: new 'Never pick Core uniques' tick box.
Gear Set Sim: two one-handed weapons (wands, for one) can now be dual wielded, and are scored against a single staff. Never with a two-hander.
Gear Set Sim: new 'Sockets on rares' setting (default up to 3). Rares get no sockets below item level 30.
Gear Set Sim: a quiver or shield left beside a weapon it can't be held with is now cleared.
Item Search: fixed a blank page when the Tier filter was set to Riven or Mythic. If your Item Search is blank, this fixes it.
Gear Set Sim: new 'Optimize idols with 1-6 affixes per idol' selector. It picks idol sizes that fit the Fossil grid (21 cells) and the best lines for each.
Gear Set Sim: new 'Max Riven mods (total)' box that limits Riven mods across the whole build, with a short explainer.
Character tab: Save item keeps an item in this browser; put it on again from Change item, under Saved, on any character or plan.
Character tab: Copy gear / Paste gear and Copy skills / Paste skills move a whole set from one character or plan to another.
Item editor: a rare can take its Oathsworn line (the Cube's 7th line) and a Scarred line (from Unswearing) under Extra lines; Riven mods are marked in the lists.
Damage: a Scarred line gets no Great or Flawless Rare boost, and boosted lines round as the game does (45 becomes 58, not 59). Checked on an in-game tooltip.
Item editor: a value outside its tier's range is flagged, and the add-affix lists are readable in dark mode.
Start a New Plan: a Continue button opens the Character tab; on the Skills tab the plan setup folds into one line.
Save Creator: a skill bar mapper under QoL puts skills on the mouse buttons, keys 1-5 and the Ctrl bar. Not tried in the game yet: keep a copy of your old save.
